decisions.reason: As a very recent launch the firm is likely to continue despite uncertainty because it has already invested in development and branding, although this product is less central to its industrial-technology direction and had only limited public prominence.

Management is likely to persist with this product because it sits squarely in the firm's established waste-to-energy offering, likely reuses existing capabilities and customer relationships, and there is no clear sign yet that weak results are permanent.
A dedicated product page signals comparatively strong public commitment and investment in a core technology area, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within the next year unlikely.

This product is close to the firm's core circular-energy business and supports its announced long-term expansion path, so management would probably keep backing it even if early market traction were mixed.
